recipe.title: Lentil, tomato and ginger curry soup

method.s: Fry leek, carrot and garlic in a pot over medium heat, stirring, for five minutes until leek is soft.
Add curry powder and cook, stirring, for a further minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, stock, ginger, chili and 2 C water.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until lentils are soft. Add more water if needed.
Stir through spinach leaves. Serve with yoghurt, garnished with pepper, chili and fresh coriander.
